item.title: Strikes, Barricades and Fiscal Turmoil: An Autumn of Discontent Grips France
item.description: Chaos in schools, on the streets and in the markets is rooted in France’s struggles to fund its social welfare state, with a presidential election approaching.

item.media:description: Students blockading their school in Marseille on Monday, part of nationwide protests of conditions at French schools.

item.title: Jim Bakker, Television Preacher Felled by Sex and Financial Scandals, Dies at 86
item.description: With his wife, Tammy Faye, Mr. Bakker built a broadcasting juggernaut around the gospel of prosperity.
item.dc:creator: Clyde Haberman
